name: Reliquary of Twilight
description: Gethin's bell-shaped lantern reliquary, which lets Cerys cross the aurora until it breaks.

timeline.summary: Cerys enters her late uncle Gethin's decayed house and finds the Reliquary of Twilight broken.
timeline.quote: The Reliquary of Twilight hadn't been used much in her uncle's final months

timeline.summary: Cerys's broken reliquary fails, and she turns on Rhain with cruel words as the Morningtide changes her.
timeline.quote: No wonder you were afraid of being cast out,

relations.note: The reliquary was Gethin's most treasured belonging.
relations.quote: to see his most treasured belonging in such a broken state

pages_say.description: Gethin's bell-shaped lantern reliquary, which lets Cerys cross the aurora until it breaks.
